The data-object must be supported by the server as defined in its capability data-object.
In the server configuration for the site, the user must have rights to perform the requested operation onthe data-object.
The input template must specify the unique identifiers of one data-object to be processed.
For WMLS_DeleteFromStore, an empty uid attribute must not be specified.

For WMLS_DeleteFromStore, a recurring element that is mandatory in the write schema must retain atleast one occurrence after the deletion.
For WMLS_GetBaseMsg, a non-empty value must be specified for ReturnValueIn.
For WMLS_GetCap, the OptionsIn keyword ‘dataVersion’ must specify a Data Schema Version that issupported by the server as defined by WMLS_GetVersion.
For WMLS_GetCap, the OptionsIn keyword ‘dataVersion’ must be specified.
For WMLS_GetFromStore, the OptionsIn keyword ‘returnElements’ must not specify a value of “headeronly” or “data-only” for a non-growing data-object.
The input template must conform to the appropriate derived schema after uncompressing the string.
The OptionsIn keyword ‘requestObjectSelectionCapability’ with a value other than ‘none’ must not bespecified with any other OptionsIn keyword.
If the OptionsIn keyword ‘requestObjectSelectionCapability’ is specified with a value other than ‘none’then QueryIn must be the Minimum Query Template.
For WMLS_GetFromStore, the logData section must not recur when retrieving data.
A client must specify an item for data-item selection that the server supports.
A client must specify an item (element or attribute) for data-object selection that the server supports.
If cascading deletes are not invoked, a client must only request deletion of bottom level data-objects suchthat all child data-objects are deleted before the parent is deleted.
A data-object with the same type and unique identifier(s) must already exist in the persistent store.
For updating systematically growing data, if data-nodes are specified then the column-identifiers(mnemonic) must be specified in the data-column-list.

For WMLS_DeleteFromStore with a systematically growing data-object, a column-identifier must not bespecified in the data-column-list (mnemonicList).
When multiple selection criteria is are included in a recurring element, the same selection items mustexist in each recurring node.
When multiple selection criteria is are included in a recurring pattern, an empty value must not bespecified.
The OptionsIn value must be a recognized keyword for that function.
The value specified with an OptionsIn keyword must be a recognized value for that keyword.
A client must not specify an OptionsIn keyword that is not supported by the server.
The value of the uom attribute is must match an ‘annotation’ attribute from the WITSML Units DictionaryXML file.
The input template must not specify more than one data-object.
For WMLS_UpdateInStore, new elements or attributes must not be empty.
For WMLS_UpdateInStore, a uom attribute must not be specified unless its corresponding value isspecified.
When adding or updating curves, column-identifiers must be unique.
For WMLS_UpdateInStore, if an element with a unique identifier in the schema is specified then theidentifier value must also be specified
When updating data in a systematically growing data-object the indexCurve must be specified in themnemonicList.
When updating data in a systematically growing data-object, each mnemonic must occur only once in themnemonicList.
When updating data in a systematically growing data-object, the unitList must always be specified.
When updating data in a systematically growing data-object, the unitList must be populated with unitsthat match the header.
For WMLS_AddToStore and WMLS_UpdateInStore, the client must always specify the unit for allmeasure data.
For a particular WMLS_AddToStore call, a client must specify all growing data-object index data in thesame unit of measure.
All datum elements or attributes for indexes in a growing data-object must implicitly or explicitly point tothe same wellDatum when adding or updating data.
The client must not attempt to add or update more data than is allowed by the server’s maxDataNodesand maxDataPoints values.
If a column-identifier representing the index column is specified then it must be specified first in the datacolumn-list.
For growing data-objects, a combination of depth and date-time structural-range indices must not bespecified.

For systematically growing data-objects, the column-identifier (mnemonic) values must not contain one ofthe following special characters: single-quote, double-quote, less than, greater than, forward slash,backward slash, ampersand, comma.
For getting systematically growing data-objects, if column-identifiers (mnemonics) are specified in boththe header and data sections then the column-identifiers must be the same in the two sections.
For getting systematically growing data-objects, if a column-definition (logCurveInfo) section is specifiedthen a mnemonic element must be specified.
For getting systematically growing data-objects, if a data-node (logData) section is specified then amnemonicList element must be specified.
For updating systematically growing data, the update data must not contain multiple nodes with the sameindex.
Each lower level child uid value must be unique within the context of its nearest recurring parent node.
